title: Audit Marketplace workspace — baseline, gaps, and questions
goal: Audit the Marketplace area to gather a baseline understanding: what exists today, what the area is trying to build, and what is missing/incomplete/needs improvement. Use deep research and sequential thinking; finish with prioritized questions for the owner to answer on how to build or fix each gap. Focus: marketplace listings, services, carts, checkout, orders, and commerce workflows

in: docs/engineering/agents/marketplace/ — charter, state, architecture, backlog, interfaces, decisions, verification, working set
The marketplace default paths declared in WORKING_SET.json
docs/engineering/generated/ — routes, api-routes, components, database-schema, permissions, integrations maps
docs/work-packets/ — existing bounded work packets for this area
.agents/ legacy specialist ledgers that document this area
out: Production code and migration changes (this is a read-only audit)
docs/admin-audit remediation stream unless findings directly affect this domain
Agent registry, task model, and opencode agent definitions

acceptance_criteria: Baseline produced as docs/engineering/agents/marketplace/BASELINE.md: what the marketplace area contains today (routes, components, services, API routes, database objects, tests, evidence), each claim backed by a real path reference; plus the area's intended direction, cited to docs/DEVELOPMENT_BACKLOG.md, docs/work-packets/, docs/engineering/agents/marketplace/BACKLOG.md, and relevant specs.
Started from the domain working set and a packet built via npm run agents:context -- --task MKT-001; expanded scope only on evidence, with the path and reason recorded in a checkpoint.

Used deep research and sequential thinking to identify everything that is missing, incomplete, or needs improvement; recorded as docs/engineering/agents/marketplace/GAPS.md, every item triaged (missing / incomplete / improve) with evidence and location.

Produced docs/engineering/agents/marketplace/QUESTIONS.md: a prioritized list of questions to the product owner explaining how to build or fix each gap (build vs fix vs drop and sequencing); the questions are also surfaced in the final checkpoint summary.
Updated docs/engineering/agents/marketplace/STATE.md (working / partial / broken / focus) and BACKLOG.md to reflect the baseline findings.
No production code or migration files changed; this is a read-only audit task (qa/release additionally honor their edit: deny permission).
npm run agents:validate passes with 0 errors before completion.
The task is not blocked on unanswered questions; owner answers become follow-up task records owned by this agent.

evidence: agents:validate 2026-09-09: 17 agents, 21 tasks validated, 0 errors, 8 pre-existing SHA warnings (generated maps). Evidence: docs/engineering/agents/marketplace/BASELINE.md, GAPS.md, QUESTIONS.md

checkpoints.summary: Marketplace baseline audit delivered. Key finding: the marketplace app code (lib/marketplace/, app/api/marketplace/**) is ~14 tables ahead of the active migration chain — marketplace_checkout_attempts, marketplace_payment_events, service_requests/offers/bookings, external_listings/clicks, post_attachments, fee_rules, ticket_collections, integration_products/sync_runs, provider_webhook_events, fulfillment_requests exist ONLY under supabase/migration-archive/pre-reconciliation-local-only-2026-08-20/ as local_only_unapplied (MANIFEST.csv), zero occurrences in generated database-objects.md; runtime degrades via schema-readiness.ts PGRST205 path. Stripe webhook route verifies signature but has no dedup ledger. Seller identity is auth-user scoped, not persona scoped. Produced BASELINE.md, GAPS.md (5 missing / 6 incomplete / 5 improve), QUESTIONS.md (10 questions, Q1 = schema pack land decision). Updated STATE.md + BACKLOG.md. Only wrote to docs/engineering/agents/marketplace/ and MKT-001.json; no production code or migrations changed.
